entry.name: rnbo_peek
entry.digest: Read values from a buffer object.
entry.description: Read sample values from specified channel of a named buffer object. Input values and indices can be specified either as event or signal values}.

arguments.name: buffername
arguments.description: Name of the buffer to read samples from.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.description: Sets the number of output channels, which determines the number of outlets that the peek object will have. If theobject being referenced by peek has more channels than the number of outputs of peek, the extra channels are not played. If theobject has fewer channels, the extra peek outputs will output 0.
